topic: A trip to the vet: Mishi is nervous and Bruno shows her how to be brave.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: Brave Little Steps

shots.narration: Vet trip today—but Mishi won't go near her carrier!
shots.scene: Cosy colourful hallway, open rounded pet carrier on a soft rug, vertical 9:16 composition.
shots.action: Mishi peeks around Bruno at the open carrier.
shots.mood: Warm morning light, Mishi's ears slightly lowered, Bruno's face gentle.

shots.narration: The carrier looks unfamiliar, and Mishi feels wobbly inside.
shots.scene: Hallway rug beside the open carrier, rounded furniture in the background.
shots.action: Mishi draws one lifted paw back against her chest.
shots.mood: Soft golden lighting, uncertain green eyes, cosy and reassuring.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno volunteers to show her how easy it is.
shots.scene: Open carrier on the hallway rug, Mishi sitting nearby.
shots.action: Bruno pokes his large black nose into the carrier doorway.
shots.mood: Playful rounded shapes, Bruno's floppy ears framing his oversized nose.

shots.narration: His nose fits perfectly. The rest? Not quite!
shots.scene: Hallway carrier entrance, clearly smaller than Bruno's chubby body.
shots.action: Bruno sits proudly with only his nose inside the doorway.
shots.mood: Bright friendly comedy, Mishi's eyes softening with amusement.

shots.narration: Mishi has an idea: make the unfamiliar feel familiar.
shots.scene: Hallway rug, a small familiar yellow blanket beside the carrier.
shots.action: Mishi points one paw toward the yellow blanket.
shots.mood: Thoughtful expression, warm colours, a small spark of confidence.

shots.scene: Open carrier on the rug, empty padded interior clearly visible.
shots.action: Bruno pushes the yellow blanket into the carrier with his nose.
shots.mood: Cosy golden light, soft blanket folds, eager helpful puppy.

shots.narration: Then he waits nearby, without rushing her.
shots.scene: Hallway floor beside the blanket-lined carrier.
shots.action: Bruno lies down beside the carrier entrance.
shots.mood: Relaxed floppy ears, patient eyes, peaceful warm lighting.

shots.scene: Close view of the open carrier doorway and yellow blanket.
shots.action: Mishi places one front paw onto the blanket inside.
shots.mood: Careful green-eyed concentration, Bruno resting quietly beside her.

shots.narration: [whispers] Another little step. Bruno stays right beside her.
shots.scene: Blanket-lined carrier in the sunny hallway, doorway fully open.
shots.action: Mishi steps completely into the carrier.
shots.mood: Gentle anticipation, relaxed whiskers, soft sunlight across grey fur.

shots.narration: She can still feel nervous and do something brave.
shots.scene: Inside the open carrier, Bruno visible just beyond its rounded doorway.
shots.action: Mishi touches her pink nose to Bruno's black nose.
shots.mood: Tender friendship, bright green eyes, warm reflected light.

shots.narration: Now her little travel nook feels cosy.
shots.scene: Hallway carrier with yellow blanket, open front door revealing the sunny garden.
shots.action: Mishi curls comfortably onto the blanket.
shots.mood: Contented kitten, proud puppy nearby, inviting morning sunshine.

shots.narration: [excited] Bravery grows together; next comes Mishi's gentle checkup!
shots.scene: Cosy hallway beside the open front door, Mishi resting inside her open carrier.
shots.action: Bruno sits beside Mishi's carrier with his chest proudly lifted.
shots.mood: Hopeful smiles, soft golden garden light, reassuring best-friend closeness.

episode.endHook: Next, Mishi and Bruno get ready for her gentle checkup!
episode.description: Mishi feels nervous about her vet trip, so Bruno helps her practise getting comfortable in her carrier. Together, they discover that bravery can begin with one tiny step.
